newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-SNIPPETS FROM THE 11TH DAY AT WIMBLEDON.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SNIPPETS FROM THE 11TH DAY AT WIMBLEDON.

text.p: Snippets from the 11th day at Wimbledon on Thursday:
Quote of the day: Boris Becker's half whisper "That was it for me" as he announced he had played his last Wimbledon.
And Pete Sampras's stunned tribute: "Wimbledon and Boris went together. This is where he made his mark as a 17-year-old and it was like his living room out there.
"He was a class act on and off the court." - - - -
Stats of the day: Martina Hingis and Jana Novotna have made it to the final but statistics since 1968 show:
The average age of a Grand Slam women's champion is 20 years two months (Hingis 16, Novotna 28)
Most common month of birth is July (Hingis September, Novotna October)
Most common star sign is Sagittarius (Novotna and Hingis both Libra)
Most common first name initial is M, as in Martina x2, Margaret, Mary, Monica.
Most common nationality is American (Hingis Swiss, Novotna Czech)
Most common place to win first Grand Slam title is at the French Open (Hingis Australian Open, Novotna yet to win)
